title.narrative: Provision of specialized protection services to mitigate the impact of the drought in Baydhaba Rural.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe ongoing drought in Baydhaba Rural, Bay Region, has intensified pre-existing protection challenges and given rise to new risks for already vulnerable populations. As per Rapid Protection Needs Assessment by CESDO and the multi-sectoral RNA conducted in Baidoa - March 2025, drought-induced displacement has significantly increased exposure to protection threats and risks, including discrimination and stigmatization, psychological abuse, and denial of access to critical resources, services, and humanitarian assistance. Affected individuals—particularly women, girls, persons with disabilities, and members of marginalized clans—face heightened risks of gender-based violence, child or forced marriage, child labour, family separation, and loss of civil documentation. Restrictions on freedom of movement, unlawful impediments to humanitarian access, and a lack of access to legal identity documents have further limited the ability of communities to seek protection and essential services. The crisis has also triggered a spike in forced evictions and increased inter-clan tensions in rural areas, where competition over dwindling resources such as land and water threatens to fuel further conflict and displacement.lt/pgtltpgtThrough this project, CESDO will strengthen and establish 2 static and 2 mobile protection desks to deliver targeted services including protection case management (PCM), Individual Protection Assistance (IPA), assistive devices for persons with disabilities, psychosocial support, and robust referral systems. Community-led protection initiatives and self-protection structures will be developed to support early identification of at-risk individuals and strengthen localized response capacity. lt/pgtltpgtThese activities will directly address the lack of sustained protection services in rural Baydhaba, enhance referral pathways, and strengthen community resilience. The project will be implemented through inclusive, protection‑centred approaches that emphasize dignity, accessibility, and accountability to affected populations.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe intervention targets 8 rural villages in Baydhaba (same as our WASH targets for complementarity) as follows: Lafaale, Gooyale, Ismoodnoy, Aw-athiinle, Bula Jaay, Daudow, Adeyki, and Arragaduud reaching ltbgt3,500 persons (1,500 women, 800 girls, 500 men and 700 boys). lt/bgtOut of this, ltbgt550 persons with disabilities lt/bgtwill be reached with ltbgtprotection interventions.lt/bgt ltbrgtlt/pgt
